This Flag Day I wanted to take a moment to think about the importance of this special symbol of our country's unity and pride. Every year on June 14th, we have a chance to show respect and pay tribute to the American flag. It represents our values, history, and dreams.

The flag is more than just a piece of cloth; it stands for the ideas and principles that define us as a nation. It represents the brave men and women in uniform who have sacrificed so much, as well as the many others who have fought for the values we believe in. It's a symbol that brings us together, no matter where we come from, reminding us of what we all strive for.

On Flag Day, let's join as a community and remember why our flag is so important to our country's story. It reminds us of our strength, unity, and resilience, especially in difficult times. The flag represents hope and freedom, inspiring us to work towards a better future.

In Congress, I’m fighting to protect and promote the values embodied in our flag. I'm proud to represent each and every one of you and fight for the rights and opportunities it symbolizes.

Thank you,

clean_body: | | | | \- - -| Peter, This Flag Day I wanted to take a moment to think about the importance of this special symbol of our country's unity and pride. Every year on June 14th, we have a chance to show respect and pay tribute to the American flag. It represents our values, history, and dreams. The flag is more than just a piece of cloth; it stands for the ideas and principles that define us as a nation. It represents the brave men and women in uniform who have sacrificed so much, as well as the many others who have fought for the values we believe in. It's a symbol that brings us together, no matter where we come from, reminding us of what we all strive for. On Flag Day, let's join as a community and remember why our flag is so important to our country's story. It reminds us of our strength, unity, and resilience, especially in difficult times. The flag represents hope and freedom, inspiring us to work towards a better future. In Congress, I’m fighting to protect and promote the values embodied in our flag. I'm proud to represent each and every one of you and fight for the rights and opportunities it symbolizes. Thank you, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. body:
On this special Flag Day, an exclusive look at last night's events from Bedminster, New Jersey, where Donald Trump delivered his prime time address.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/e041c39f9fd8/ir-exclusive-from-bedminster-flag-day-special-edition?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illinois Review eBlast Powered By
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

IR Exclusive: Trump Delivers Prime Time Speech from Bedminster Hours after Biden Administration Arrests Top Political Opponent and Leading Candidate for GOP Nomination for President (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/ir-exclusive-trump-delivers-prime-time-speech-from-bedminster-hours-after-biden-administration-arrests-top-political-opponent-and-leading-candidate-for-gop-nomination-for-president.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
President Trump delivers a prime time speech from his club in Bedminster, New Jersey on June 13, 2023. (Source: Illinois Review)

In scenes that usually play out on state-owned television in countries like Cuba, Venezuela, China and Russia, on Tuesday, the Biden administration officially arrested a political opponent and the leading candidate for the Republican nomination for President of the United States – as the 45th President – President Donald Trump, pled “not guilty” during an arraignment hearing in Miami’s Federal Courthouse earlier in the day for charges alleging he mishandled his own classified documents.

The indictment and arrest of President Trump on 37 felony charges is yet another example of the Biden administration weaponizing federal agencies to take out a political enemy.
President Trump arrives via his helicopter to deliver a prime time address at his club in Bedminster, New Jersey on June 13, 2023. (Source: Illinois Review)

Former US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton lied and misled federal authorities about her mishandling of classified information, even destroying the evidence. And what was the outcome? No charges.

President Joe Biden mishandled classified information when he was vice president, storing highly sensitive documents at his downtown Washington, DC think tank and in his garage at home. And what was the outcome? No charges.
Guests await the arrival of President Trump to deliver a prime time address from his club in Bedminster, New Jersey on June 13, 2023. (Source: Illinois Review)

A search of former Vice President Mike Pence’s home uncovered classified information from his time as vice president, and what was the outcome? No charges.

It’s no wonder a majority of Americans do not trust our legal system – it’s rigged against anyone who is not part of the Washington establishment.

On Tuesday evening – only hours after surrendering in a Miami federal courthouse, President Trump delivered a prime time speech from his private club in Bedminster, New Jersey – where he resides during the summer months.
Illinois Review Publisher Scott Kaspar, left and Brett Corrigan, right, at President Trump’s club in Bedminster, New Jersey just hours before Trump’s prime time speech on June 13, 2023. (Source: Illinois Review)

Illinois Review Publisher Scott Kaspar, and a member at Trump’s properties, was on hand for the big speech, and went live on Illinois Review’s Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/illinois.review/videos/979840430098028/?extid=CL-UNK-UNK-UNK-IOS_GK0T-GK1C&mibextid=2Rb1fB&ref=sharing&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to cover the prime time address from a reserved seat in the front row.

The guest list was a who’s who among the former president’s orbit, including My Pillow CEO Mike Lindell; former NYC Police Commissioner Bernard Kerik; Ambassador Richard Grenell; and US Senator Tommy Tuberville.
https://www.northjersey.com/picture-gallery/news/politics/2023/06/13/trump-indictment-national-golf-club-bedminster-nj/12101193002/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former New York City Police Commissioner Bernard Kerik, left, and Illinois Review Publisher Scott Kaspar outside Trump National Golf Club in Bedminster, New Jersey on June 13, 2023. (Source: Mike Kelly/NorthJersey.com)

During his speech, Trump called special prosecutor Jack Smith “Deranged Jack Smith,” saying “he’s a behind-the-scenes guy, but his record is absolutely atrocious. He does political hit jobs.”

Smith was the prosecutor in the case against former Virginia Gov. Bob McDonnell – a case that made it all the way to the US Supreme Court, where the justices unanimously reversed the lower court’s decision in an
8-0 vote (https://www.cnn.com/2016/06/27/politics/bob-mcdonnell-supreme-court/index.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – in a dramatic and devastating blow to Smith and his team of federal prosecutors.

The case and subsequent decision even inspired liberal justice
Stephen Breyer (https://rollcall.com/2016/04/27/supreme-court-may-be-ready-to-side-with-mcdonnell/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to conclude that “the uncontrolled power of criminal prosecutors is a threat to our separation of powers.”

MSNBC and CNN chose not to cover Trump’s speech, instead opting to discuss the arraignment earlier in the day.

CNN’s
Jake Tapper (https://www.forbes.com/sites/markjoyella/2023/06/14/cnn-msnbc-refuse-to-air-trumps-post-indictment-litany-of-lies/?sh=f9126ce4ea97&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8d703eae43-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_06_14_09_34&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8d703eae43-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , during live TV explained that the network would not be covering Trump’s speech because “he says a lot of things, frankly, that are not true and sometimes potentially dangerous.”

Fox News, Newsmax and Illinois Review covered the speech in its entirety.

Best birthday wishes to the 45th President!

body:

Derek, I just
left the House floor.

Moments ago, the MAGA Republican effort to censure and fine me $16 million
for holding Donald Trump accountable and leading Trump’s impeachment
failed on a bipartisan vote.

I won’t kid you, it wasn’t pleasant listening to the clerk read this false
and defamatory resolution before the whole Congress. But then the most
incredible thing happened — almost one out of every ten Republicans voted
against it. The MAGA resolution was too much even for them.

But I want you to know, this wasn’t just an attack on me — it was an
attack on our democracy and the institution of Congress — and one fully
supported by Speaker Kevin McCarthy. This debacle was just another example
of how far MAGA GOP extremists will go to seek political retribution to
avenge Trump’s campaign. And though it failed, almost 200 MAGA Republicans
went along with it.

But make no mistake: This wasn’t the far-right’s first attack against me,
and it sure as hell won’t be the last. They will do whatever it takes to
deter me from holding Donald Trump and his accomplices accountable, and
keep me from being elected to the Senate.

They’ll continue going after me in the coming months to distract from
Trump’s legal peril, to gratify Trump and his base, and try to tear down
someone they feel is his most effective adversary.

In fact, as I was walking off the floor, Rep. Anna Paulina Luna – a woman
I’ve not met until today and couldn’t have picked out of a lineup – let me
know that she’s filing another censure resolution next week, “and this one
will pass.”

They are not giving up. But I’ve got news for them, neither am I. I will
continue defending our democracy against the twice-impeached,
twice-indicted, ex-president and his lackeys.

body:

Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice
(DOJ) for records disclosing the names of staffers working in Special
Counsel Jack Smith’s office on two investigations targeting former
President Donald Trump and other Americans.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64845037/411452275/1224595648?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjYwMDg4Mi0xNTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FV3QW0gbov_mPx_pLaft9_969vUJiV8p6hQEZ5D174M=)
Hello Peter -- I hope you’re well.

I know it's been a while since my last email, but I do hope you'll take a moment to read this one -- because it's important. **I wanted to make sure you saw the news that I’ve endorsed my friend George Whitesides in the race for CA-27.**

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA Faith
subject: It's time for revival
body:
Our nation needs REVIVAL.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zppmahp20o1cj8vsf854atf6nvnfanro6888gfj8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs)
---
Fellow American, **Our nation needs _REVIVAL_.** These are dark and trying times for America, and now more than ever, we need to turn to our great God for peace... for hope... for victory. That’s why TPUSA Faith has launched our **Kingdom to the Capitol Tour** \-- a series of live worship events in ALL FIFTY STATE CAPITALS over the next several months designed to ignite the flame of REVIVAL in bible-believing Americans across the country! We’re traveling from state to state and gathering _tens of thousands_ of believers together to seek the face of our Heavenly Father and invite his blessing on our great nation. And we’re praying for the partnership of friends like you as we continue building momentum for this movement. In fact, we can’t do it without you! [**As a friend, a fellow believer, and a lover of our great country, can I count on you to partner with TPUSA Faith in this important initiative by making a generous gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, or whatever the Lord leads you to give today?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z10mphdut08am2uli9o4gndcb4md16i455and3s8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs)
---
[**GIVE NOW >>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4c0l9talpjsfsanblttd1lnu4380o2c7f7slcn8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs)
---
Your generous partnership will enable us to promote these powerful worship events far and wide in our upcoming cities ... to fill local church buildings with worshipers ... and to send an army of believers back into their communities with renewed hope and power to bring revival to our nation when it's needed most. Whether it’s the spread of socialism, gender ideology in public schools, the scourge of abortion, or the recent tragic shooting at a Nashville Christian school, you don’t have to look hard to see the darkness plaguing our country when it drifts from the truth of scripture. But followers of Jesus know the promises that the Lord has made to the nation that turns back to him. We know that he is gracious to forgive us, and to lavish his mercy and blessings on his people. And that’s exactly what we’re pleading with the Lord to grant as we seek His face in worship at these powerful events. [**But we can’t do it without you. Will you please make your generous and much-needed gift right now?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zofmllgk3mg9h0ndnbqvjnssp9l3cfob46mp1rko_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs) Together, we can make these the first of many thousands to have their hearts and lives invigorated by these powerful worship events. [**Your generous gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, or whatever the Lord leads you to give will enable us to bring hundreds more people to our Kingdom to the Capitol worship events -- until we've hosted one in EVERY state capital in America! -- over the next several months.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4p0usarcfbt948kthjjch221fm9s5bubj423158_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs)
---
[**GIVE NOW >>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhrvr0jdnf0vihsan3e8nhn20o50nqjr3hntkj4o_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs)
---
Right now, we have events scheduled in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma; Austin, Texas; Topeka, Kansas; Madison, Wisconsin; Springfield, Illinois; Indianapolis, Indiana; and many more. These important events, empowered by the Holy Spirit and made possible by your generous partnership, have the potential to bring the hope of the Gospel to every state capital in America. These are desperate times for our nation. Now is the time to bring God’s kingdom near. That’s exactly what TPUSA Faith is doing with our Kingdom to the Capitol Tour. [**Will you please pray and give today to help move this mission forward for the glory of God, for the good of America, and for the good of our world?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjaj34eqikkedsh147u520s3aa1u9s586qpjsfa8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3h6coj4cph2bs) Just imagine the national revival that our great God could begin through us! God bless you,
---
Charlie KirkTPUSA Faith

| | | | | Peter, **Will we let Republicans keep criminalizing abortion in states around the country?? **_Sure, we've had great victories in Michigan & Minnesota. _Yet, recently, as The Guardian pointed out:
> _Nebraska's state legislature passed a 12-week ban.., days after another 12-week ban cleared its final hurdle in North Carolina._
Recently South Carolina was added to this list with an even more cruel six-week ban. _We must stop them from adding Virginia to that list!_ [**We have only a one vote pro-choice majority in the VA State Senate, as _one "Democratic" Senator, Joe Morrissey, is anti-choice. But, we can replace him in only 5 days _****_with progressive champion, Laschrecse Aird!_ **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1370c8b0-6db8-4aaa-accb-471655c38822/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **_Aird has specifically labeled her campaign "Roe not Joe" _(as in Morrissey)**. She has the support of every female VA State Senate Democrat, Congresswoman Abigail Spanberger and many male VA State House & State Senate members. _Again, we have **only FIVE DAYS until an election **that may **determine whether millions of VA women retain their right to choose, or a "Democrat" joins Gov. Youngkin and a GOP State House to pass a full ban.**_ [**_Will you please join Blue Amp Action's own "Roe Not Joe," campaign by giving Lashrecse Aird $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can, so she can replace Morrissey as a critical vote to protect abortion rights in Virginia?_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5a47f361-fe69-44bf-857a-360ddd72914b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for fighting for all women in Virginia and around the country. ## Penny Indicted For Subway Chokehold
A grand jury has [indicted Marine vet Daniel Penny](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvhCAUwPFPgxvm8fAQB4Ymjdt1aZqOBuGpXDkwSO_it2_aufN_-ef3eZ2uNsSQ1jd7J1OXPFlXw4MmUFxcOMoJG28WIiTZkBFKK41aDV2zmWGRgCAF0QXRz2roSdBitdZ-gLmzTTAIKEGJiwAQcmiF7oDE7DsxCyDnWAfkQ82lveWQ6kZLPPODSuvyvYlmq3U_mHxhODIc7ewSPY92zb-Z4fjxznBci02e377LyUPywdWDe5sCRb5TSid3W_6iLUfPPdm68Vsu3iaG41FzOZkcg2fyVQBA3-uhb4rx-zPEGA7Vsw7Wuw3xb6f-r_MTAAD__6DCZeE) in connection with Jordon Neely's death by chokehold on a NY subway, law enforcement sources say.

The specific charges won't be made public until Penny appears in court, but he was arrested on second-degree manslaughter charges. He says he acted to defend himself and others in the subway car. ([See video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2SqyAAR_Gn0Q6HLwkWFLexy223dAj8jWQRMkDi-vY7u_XWpznz-7guVxtiSPf_dodpa16sa-GNhSrCRsLFwntvVoBD9DBMaaW5VpPsN0PFxUvu9AQ2qmkU3lKnqNSgXuCieR8Mp1xQxUZGKRPTwLSkYDcv2Y1RONdJCh9aLsMjh9Q2rPHMb5TB5b2PZmvtWTvxr-Nzx-fjOIY1fyUc9ad3fH7Vjs-7LSGBvNFQbCLepoBInkjpJCH54Bo8qa_bYU_itvyJLUdPPGzbyCMXbxNJQDxJza_iUPti_PMIMYaqLp2k992G-DvU_vb5DgAA___9vWnA))

Witnesses say that Neely, a homeless man known to be mentally unstable, was threatening and harassing passengers. By using the chokehold, Penny put himself at the center of a heated public debate over vigilante justice.
## Modelo Passes Bud Light as No. 1 Beer
Bud Light has been [dethroned as America's best-selling beer](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7oh2F7zGBcVr0uW1V1oYlpgTDpbNJbq_P-XqK0dTjDQft_nmc8mP-3-_iWupzj60_JQZWOGgSM_UR5dESHQvDtmyJcuT6Vc3IY0YmIZpiYMBJvRhHC2BRI4o2GdHQBoYBwRAPV3QGhBcosEFQULoDEjMrR6Xz5ofbZVUvutTjkuoW1_c2tp-dvpfR9eOrn5_yOt8qzccLYciHV2Xr6hKvq9NLSKH2mqUUtXpi5xKD3EZga3m4LWNQxKcTJi014kNptQfLu6vXEo-eewM3Defy2-8_f3iJwAA__-bOl3a) by Modelo Especial, following months of continuing sales declines driven by a conservative boycott.

Bud Light has been the nation's sales leader since 2001, a brand made famous by its [funny and creative TV ads](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uwyAYAJ8Gtlj8GwaGphFTU3XraGH4iKlwsGwSy29ftV073XDSSfd5Ha4-l3y_vfsZbEt18KHlJwxEnag8MT4wHG0CYMAxWKq00kwrI_BkQyCjJJ7z3gRIQkqWDPXUJMWjjlLhbBlhnCgqKSGUm45qQYCOUdCREggBCQIxt7p2XzXf2wSpHPUJaxfqjIudWls2xF8Qc4i5fd-7oz7aY4Qfj5hbij9K3hri7g-XjzfRCyFez65Xzlwu-oxXG5c9l5I31SNBbrPP5bff_t_9DgAA___WTVSU). But a sales promotion featuring trans influencer Dylan Mulvaney sparked a ferocious backlash.

Retail sales for Bud Light [were down 24%](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L-OozAQgPGnMZ3RzACOKVzcFXS55ootkf-MwSsHR9hJlLdf7dZbf82n38d1vdqU07H9szc2LZbV-paevIKSOEkaVuqCiczEQ8cGlVaatJrHbjcTko1ehRmJtQ_REUYHVrnZDSrEsUuGgAZQOCEADnOPegRGF0Z0COy9GIFDauXsP0s62s4xv8uTz96XW5fN3tq9iuGPoEXQYp0_-FX7rXxnQcvfR00H1ypoeaWT_7dyvgUt7hFkTtveZCt3-aiycs58SgJAmUvlKqvNXCUCwGWatO5OE-6vlHOq6iJG2G425Z-H9jvJVwAAAP__zUpieA) the week ending June 3, while Modelo Especial sales were up 12%. Both companies have said they're pumping extra money into marketing this summer.
## Fired Starbucks Manager Wins $25M Lawsuit
A federal jury** **[awarded $25 million](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1y8yAQAJ9G6uThACFUUHyNO39tSs0Bh3UJ-hnA9uTtM06dcmebnf24LTfkzPv9P27kWjoWDI2ftAgzwDhItcg-ukQkSfXkwFhjpTWz7leXrElaodWgIBkvVJyEScooj15Po-rZSSGVMDCCEKDmC1gtCHzU4EFQCJ0WFLkd5fJ58N5WSvn7eFK5hGPrs1tbO2un_nXy2skrnju96lu9oTQOmTp5rQ2Lf4SvOhQMXLfhXDljpHyujMOGO96pDBlf9cFt8AnnEGe08xRT0kImO-opgZn0OEYQfXHxfHHOXM3UaXHfkPNvTvv7zk8AAAD__3z5Zag) to Shannon Phillips, a white Starbucks regional manager fired after an incident in Philadelphia where two Black men were refused access to the bathroom.

Phillips wasn't involved in the incident, and the jury agreed with her claim that Starbucks fired her [because she was white](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskTGPozAQhX-N6Sayx-BAQREpotvrTldGg2cA3wJGthNu__0pW2_1pPcVT3rfn4_HB4U17PMv2qQvU3yQL-ElD-3ANID2gRX3kwiKraQ3rnUttq6rq6VH67VcmytTZ0jXDfrJjWZqLDM3I0kVetRotTON0drY7mLaWosZuTaj0eK9qrVwKDFd_sawl0Wm9Su-JF183Kq1X0o5srI3hYPC4TzPy5b3N1M4yA7PrHDY5XyHT2EThUMulMan_8yw0U6zJDiXCIl2OJawrl-QS0wC5yJJoJwRxpX8J2yyw_mukkzPLAzkveQMJcJIZUkxbjBLyYDNe5wS3G7G_1s6VnaIPrCy9y0Lz7wcCt3hlb3_bqxR6PzrmzoWba1FYuKaRciPxK0mmmrUtReFToKy92tXpZ6PM6xryO6qaj1vFNbvR8rPgv4HAAD__-Wbkdg), a violation of her civil rights.

In addition to the $25 million Starbucks owes in punitive damages, the jury also awarded her $600,000 in compensatory damages.

name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: It's not personal - it's about principles
body:
|
---
| | |
---
| The Mississippi Freedom Caucus (MFC) often comes under fire, even in our own Republican party. Recently, an establishment-picked-candidate said not to trust us or any of our endorsed candidates running this year. We understand during an election year, the establishment will say and do anything they can to keep true conservatives out of office, but we thought we’d explain what we stand for. We understand that not all conservatives agree on everything, and certainly other “Republicans” don’t agree with some of our principles. But we are a principle-based organization of Republican Legislators, so when other elected officials come out against the MFC, it's not because of personalities, but because of principles. Our basic principles are founded on Individual Liberty, Free Markets, Limited Government, and Minimal Taxation. As a matter of fact, our beliefs are very much in line with our Mississippi Republican Party’s own [platform](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/Q-MwMROHytaPK1FeXhWiZg):
> We believe that people, not government, know best how to spend their own money. When people keep more of their hard-earned money, jobs and economic growth will flourish in the free market system. We support the reduction of the tax burden on our citizens. We believe our tax burden is too high, our tax code is too complicated, and our tax system is inefficient. Government must be open in proceedings and accountable for the use of tax dollars. We believe in the traditional, conservative values that America was founded upon.
During the session we kept a vote tracker [FreedomVotes.ms](http://freedomvotes.ms/) so that anyone could see how we rate bills and why we vote the way we do. We tie every bill analysis back to our principles. So again, when someone attacks our caucus because of our votes, they aren’t attacking us for our personalities, but our principles. Principles which align with the constitution and our Republican party. So, one has to ask themselves, if someone is attacking the Freedom Caucus based on our principles, what principle exactly is it that they don’t agree with? Freedom? Liberty? Limited governments and minimal taxation? Maybe all of those principles? The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is aligned with and developed from the ideals of the House Freedom Caucus in the U.S. House of Representatives. They are the only conservatives currently fighting in D.C. for sensible fiscal responsibility and to stop the Biden Administration’s out of control spending. They are the only true conservatives willing to buck the status quo in D.C. and actually fight against the swamp. There will always be people who think they are conservatives, and call themselves Republicans, but philosophically disagree with our principles and side more with the Democrats. But our principles are worth standing up for and we won’t back down. Our principles are the only ones that can save our state and country, and they are worth fighting for.
---

| | Peter,

Head fake: an act of moving the head in such a way as to deceive an opponent as to one's intended direction or move. As I look at today's seemingly-endless news cycle, national headlines, and constant outrage, I look for the head fake. What is happening behind the scenes? What have we missed among the noise?

Well, the [video below (click the thumbnail)](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=70b2774f64&e=9828080a05) details something extremely disturbing: substandard medical publications were used to push and promote narratives and squash other narratives. AND NOW those publications are being silently deleted. [Please watch the alarming video below detailing this and share it if you can:](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=2a9f19c597&e=9828080a05)

---
| Hundreds of medical journals are disappearing, and no one is talking about it! I’ve never seen this in my 40 years of practicing medicine.

As the noise grows louder in media and politics, it seems like the powers of Big Tech, Big Pharma, and Big Government are attempting to memory hole the overreach they imposed on us for 3 years. I wrote about their raw power in my book, ["_We've Been Played_."](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=7bca2545cc&e=9828080a05)

As tensions rise and a never-ending cycle of news is shoved in our faces, we have to pay attention to the quiet, creeping tyranny. [This is just one huge example.](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=9f46a8bb3c&e=9828080a05)

Stay vigilant.

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

### VIRGINIA OPIOID SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT

Virginia is set to receive approximately $365.6 million in compensation following opioid agreements made with Teva, Allergen, CVS and Walgreens. The settlement includes additional injunctive relief -- requirements that each company must follow.
The $365.6 million will start being distributed to state and local governments by the end of 2023.
---
| |
### PRESCRIPTION DISCOUNT CARDS COMING TO ROANOKE

The National League of Cities, the city of Roanoke and CVS Caremark have rolled out a program in Roanoke to provide prescription discounts for people who don't have insurance or whose insurance doesn't cover their prescriptions.
The program, called My Healthy Hometown, said it "can save up to 80% off retail on generics and up to 40% on name brand medications."

### [Jennifer Carroll Foy for SD-33 ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vdNnoIkP4EmmJFwIQnshjtDThkObBa0evFlTx4AAZpb4Xj1NE5X6SJ_lp4ZCNnHL6gfduCtQLHq4xY4G4ugcsQ8xfDOVGZklJzuWwZn4D4JCzXzK9csugtSU43a5QUJm5c-cBssRZwo_HQ_DtZughgiu4XiIegx8&c=odsEBPWoy1O6x4u_Z9oqYvht-Ocv4dO73350r49lmwOlKvYctPIHIg==&ch=49oYsAHdLCFp8n6MsnP54rMY25xjvj1KfP7a9aja8hcofvdYeOCOeg==)

Jennifer Carroll Foy was one of the first African-American women to graduate from Virginia Military Institute, is a former foster mom, magistrate judge, public defender, and Delegate. Her lifelong experience has driven her determination to get results for Virginians -- ratifying the Equal Rights Amendment, expanding Medicaid to roughly 500,000 Virginians, raising the minimum wage, expanding broadband, cleaning up toxic coal ash and providing opportunities for veterans to start businesses. She is incredibly proud to have helped lead the charge for bold progress here in Virginia.
She believes we are at a critical juncture for our Commonwealth, where so much of our progress has the potential to be reversed. That's why she is stepping up to serve her community and move Virginia forward.

Somewhere along the way, America forgot it was founded on truth. The politicians and media don't want you to be reminded of these facts.

Fellow American,

**TRUTH.** There's only one. Not yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic political climate where spin is all the Administrative state knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to say them:

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom – even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
-
Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,
-
Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,
-
Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,
-
Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,
-
Protecting the unborn,

Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

Expanding education freedom,

subject: Ten Truths, No Lies

body:
Somewhere along the way, America forgot it was founded on truth. The politicians and media don't want you to be reminded of these facts.

| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c668498%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=L0rlSM991R1%2b8vzqTV3rpQ&sysid=1)

Fellow American,

**TRUTH.** There's only one. Not yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic political climate where spin is all the Administrative state knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to say them:

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** CHIP IN IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c668499%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZSD56gDK1Yn4alA7QulxDQ&sysid=1)
---

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. **Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.**

If you agree with these 10 TRUTHS, _**[I need you on my team.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c668490%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MkFtLUJ3ki5qz8ZVUxFSnQ&sysid=1)**_

This is about more than a campaign. It is a movement to revive this great nation. **[Will you join me today by chipping in $1 or more?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c668491%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZEVjfenfoRU2SHIy51FHSA&sysid=1)**

Vivek Ramaswamy

[** STAND WITH THE TRUTH **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c668492%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9n%2flnFONAJePaFOgzEaxog&sysid=1)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

These are serious charges, and I want to talk about them. | Friend, By now you’ve heard that Donald Trump was indicted on 37 felony counts for stealing top secret documents from the government, refusing to give them back, and obstructing justice in the process. I’ve held two focus groups with Republican voters since the news broke, and not one person said it made them support Trump less. But many said it makes them support him more. This is what I call the “rally ‘round Trump effect.” But I’m not ready to give up on the voters. That’s why this week we ran a six-figure ad takeover of Fox News, highlighting the latest indictment and Trump’s wrongdoing. This aired on Tuesday on every Fox News show from Fox & Friends through The Ingraham Angle—right up to when Trump spoke at Bedminster. These are hardcore pro-Trump shows, and the more viewers we can reach with the truth, the better. Trump is maintaining a big lead in the polls over his rivals. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I still have my voice
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar.
#

Friends -
Twelve years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I still have my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230615-1-subs&t=1&akid=5967%2E3935704%2E5Mp9jF)
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230615-1-subs&t=2&akid=5967%2E3935704%2E5Mp9jF)
I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting—or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day—I know how hard it can be.
But friends, we can’t give up. I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. Even on the hardest days, we can never lose hope.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230615-1-subs&t=3&akid=5967%2E3935704%2E5Mp9jF)
This month, fundraising has been a challenge for GIFFORDS PAC. We have our mid-month fundraising deadline tonight, and we’re still not quite where we need to be.
So this is where I need to ask for your help:
[**Will you make your first online contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today? We can’t reach our June fundraising goals without your support.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jun23.dfqeaL&refcode=em230615-1-subs&t=4&akid=5967%2E3935704%2E5Mp9jF)

clean_body: I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. Friends - Twelve years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson. Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out. Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I still have my voice. The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey. I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting—or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day—I know how hard it can be. But friends, we can’t give up. I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. Even on the hardest days, we can never lose hope. This month, fundraising has been a challenge for GIFFORDS PAC. We have our mid-month fundraising deadline tonight, and we’re still not quite where we need to be. Six years ago, when I told friends and family that I was going to run for Congress, I'm sure most of them thought it was crazy and wondered _"Why would he ever want to do that?"_
My answer? If I have concerns about what is happening in our country, what am I going to do about it? I never planned to run for elected office, but my parents instilled in me a commitment to a life of service and someone had to step up. I'm not going to assume someone else will fight my fights for me. **I believe that government can be a force for good in people's lives and, as one of my earliest mentors told me, that you can't have good government without good people in government.**
Six years ago, we were halfway through Trump's presidency. Only 20% of Americans had trust in their government according to Pew. Today Donald Trump is facing 37 felony charges and multiple ongoing investigations. And still that trust number remains painfully stagnant. Stuck because of partisan knife fighting, corruption, weakened democratic institutions and a sense that government isn't working for the people it ought to be serving. It's a sad day for our country.
**Like you, I didn't need to see this indictment to know how dangerous unchecked ego, a culture of corruption, and a trust deficit are to our republic.**
_But you know what?_
I'm still hopeful about America.
We can pass strong ethics rules, ensure transparency, strengthen our democratic institutions, and restore peoples' trust in government.
To do that, we have to support good people who are willing to work hard and fight for our democracy. I still believe now more than ever that you truly can't have good government without good people in government.
_Andy_

subject: Former Home Depot CEO issues dire warning for Americans
body:
Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy’s are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> "We’re going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years..."
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she’s found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhlrtpnjn82st87hqsolhqf4ujn867gnpjfiktr0_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im0oj2chh2bs) Dr. Prins says:
> ** "This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we’re about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result." **
According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she’s recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a 'reset' to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. [Click here now to see her full (and free) presentation.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd999udcs2ql87uuv43t52hvltjavd7ctumnaiv0_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im0oj2chh2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura
Senior Managing Editor, Rogue Economics **P.S.** The last time we saw a similar transformations to our money, folks who failed to prepare were blindsided. But those who moved their money beforehand had the opportunity to multiply their nest-egg as a result. [Click here to see why.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zdmavide5tv31lv1e3u8d1me1qn1el68lt65bcq0_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im0oj2chh2bs)

name: Colin Allred
subject: Inside Elections just downgraded Ted Cruz's chances
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
Peter, a lot of folks told me not to run against Ted Cruz.

They said a Democrat can't win a statewide election in Texas and that I
should stick with my "safe" seat in the House after winning with 66% of
the vote last year. But I'm not one to play it safe when our rights and
values are in danger.

And listen, this team raised more in the first 24 hours of our campaign
than Cruz did in the entire first quarter of 2023 – and the experts are
taking notice.

Already, the Cook Political Report upgraded our chances of winning, and
both Roll Call AND Inside Elections officially moved Texas from "Solid
Republican" to "Battleground"!

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18970?t=1001&akid=3314%2E346206%2EgsKU8O ]Peter, all of these experts are putting Ted Cruz on notice
because of the early strength of our grassroots campaign – but you know
that GOP donors are taking notice, too. So please, will you chip in a
split donation between my campaign and Charles Booker before my critical
end-of-month deadline to help fight back against the GOP, beat Ted Cruz
and flip Texas blue? I need to raise $100,000 today →

I've never felt better about our chances. Nate Silver's FiveThirtyEight
says Texas may be Democrats' best pickup opportunity next year, CNN is
calling Cruz one of the most vulnerable incumbents on the ballot and, if
we win in Texas, Democrats will hold the Senate Majority.

But CBS News says this could be one of the most expensive races in the
country, and with Senate control hanging in the balance, national
Republicans are pouring money into Cruz's war chest. They've already
launched their first attacks, and if we miss our fundraising goals, I
won't have the resources to fight back.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18970?t=1002&akid=3314%2E346206%2EgsKU8O ]That's why I'm personally asking: Will you split a donation of $30 or
more between my campaign and Charles Booker? Every dollar helps as we work
to defeat Ted Cruz, flip Texas blue and protect our Democratic Senate
majority →

Let's do this.

Colin Allred

Somewhere along the way, America forgot it was founded on truth. The politicians and media don't want you to be reminded of these facts.

| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3aa3mt6i7krd8tvh43gf0lvhneoul91nkbmo570_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im8p36clh2bs)

Fellow American,

**TRUTH.** There's only one. Not yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic political climate where spin is all the Administrative state knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to say them:

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** CHIP IN IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi77ubgs8478hjuv4sdp1e0se6jfkjgj1uvb3p00_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im8p36clh2bs)

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. **Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.**

If you agree with these 10 TRUTHS, _**[I need you on my team.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z81ah4r67742jdjlq2g7mcba8vnvlb3pvk0kgih8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im8p36clh2bs)**_

This is about more than a campaign. It is a movement to revive this great nation. **[Will you join me today by chipping in $1 or more?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0qmj717ishjqp1ubenseebgc6shujrissvkt7oo_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im8p36clh2bs)**

Thanks,

[** STAND WITH THE TRUTH **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj3u5c563boeo825j530fil3j0teampo8e62sieo_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3im8p36clh2bs)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Here’s why we so urgently need your financial support now.

We are fighting to keep our elections honest**...**

In just the past 6 months, we have settled our clean voter roll lawsuits against **Colorado** and **Pennsylvania** , after they began cleaning their voter rolls and agreed to provide us with voter roll data for the next six years (**Colorado**) and annual reports on their voter roll cleaning efforts for the next five years (**Pennsylvania**)!

The challenges to honest elections are enormous... _and ongoing,_ [which is why your decision to give us your support today is so critically important!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63782&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

---

**_We are investigating and prosecuting serious allegations and evidence of
_ _Biden family corruption_.**

In light of stunning bank records recently released by the U.S. House of Representatives Government Oversight and Accountability Committee, we have sued the National Archives for **_thousands of documents_** that could shed further light on massive Biden family corruption, _including criminal connections with businesses controlled by the Chinese Communist Party_. The Dominant Media tries to bury this story... _but Judicial Watch is using the legal system and the courts to make sure they don 't succeed_!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63782&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

**_We continue to file lawsuits exposing Marxist "Critical Race Theory" in public schools and our military._**

Our lawsuits forced the release of documents proving that the Biden team is infiltrating the curricula of the **U.S. Military Academy** , the **U.S Naval Academy** and the **U.S.****Air Force Academy** with Critical Race Theory (CRT) and other racist propaganda!

Judicial Watch broke open the scandal of public funds being used to spread CRT poison in our schools and _we won 't stop until all the ugly facts about this Marxist indoctrination are exposed_!

**_We keep fighting to expose the Fauci Covid scandal_**.

We filed multiple lawsuits against federal agencies for public records to shed light on the China origins of the pandemic, and on U.S. Government funding (by Fauci's agency) of "gain of function" research at China's controversial Wuhan Institute of Virology, which may have led directly to the spread of Covid.

The American people deserve to know the facts about how and where the Covid-19 pandemic arose, and how much U.S. funding went to the pandemic's source!

[**Your contribution today will help us keep fighting for our "right to know" on all these critically important fronts.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63782&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63782&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

_Thanks to our members’ generous support_ , Judicial Watch is doing the work that the Dominant Media and the Department of Justice should be doing... _but won 't_!

**And as I said before, we are carrying** the largest and most important caseload in our history... _and additional support from patriotic Americans like you is vital to our success_.

I believe in this American Greatness. I've spent my life fighting for it. Long before I was elected governor, I served our nation in Iraq as a JAG officer in support of SEAL Team 1. Having seen what the attacks of September 11th did to our country, I felt a responsibility to do my part to help at a time of struggle. _**So I served**_. Friend, the sense of satisfaction I got knowing that I was wearing the cloth of my country, serving alongside so many honorable patriots, and fighting for something bigger than myself was a satisfaction that money just can't buy. Today, our country has lost its sense of national pride.
* Instead of strengthening our military recruiting efforts and building a military for the future...
* Instead of securing our border and holding Mexican drug cartels accountable for the irrevocable harm they've done to our citizens...
* And instead of reigning in out-of-control economic and fiscal policy that have left us on the brink of bankruptcy...

...**the Left has been too busy distracting our nation with the woke Olympics.** I find this unacceptable. _**I am ready to keep my campaign promises, restore an energetic executive to the White House, and get the job done**_. I recently took my message directly to the people of Iowa, New Hampshire, and South Carolina, and I will continue to spread the message each and every day until we've won...until we've righted this ship...until we've achieved our Great American Comeback.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

This fight is more important than ever |
#
Team, The GOP is still lining up behind Donald Trump to defend him— even after his recent indictment laid out evidence of a brazen attempt to obstruct justice. We need leaders we can trust to defend the rule of law. body:
These are dark and trying times for America, and now more than ever, we need to turn to our great God for peace... for hope... for victory.

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=75fc9776751c44f2b96717dca495b1f4&_e=RZZuKsOEJPUSK0DE7BFTdnmrMdCnd60NR6ygl393gvtSJQNn94uLwNp9R9AL5hGIYyiG2vGwdqD94gDgeyUMBDsZ_Z-C6hiSoIuL7nJ_xpWgd9LzuJyeuDhRoer78rnEZk3x7-wYD-WTyJz34l_nGafXs2PXYs4LUUG4SBCWHaecZS8Q6XElzJE1s0UCgciNqkS9z53IRCEl0_muVAEtyVLOjZemhk1ziuJw6l7mdb2Bm7rvQya7RZ1TME9FVtbA)

Fellow American, **Our nation needs _REVIVAL_.** These are dark and trying times for America, and now more than ever, we need to turn to our great God for peace... for hope... for victory. That's why TPUSA Faith has launched our **Kingdom to the Capitol Tour** \-- a series of live worship events in ALL FIFTY STATE CAPITALS over the next several months designed to ignite the flame of REVIVAL in bible-believing Americans across the country! We're traveling from state to state and gathering _tens of thousands_ of believers together to seek the face of our Heavenly Father and invite his blessing on our great nation. And we're praying for the partnership of friends like you as we continue building momentum for this movement. In fact, we can't do it without you! Whether it's the spread of socialism, gender ideology in public schools, the scourge of abortion, or the recent tragic shooting at a Nashville Christian school, you don't have to look hard to see the darkness plaguing our country when it drifts from the truth of scripture. But followers of Jesus know the promises that the Lord has made to the nation that turns back to him. We know that he is gracious to forgive us, and to lavish his mercy and blessings on his people. And that's exactly what we're pleading with the Lord to grant as we seek His face in worship at these powerful events. [**But we can 't do it without you. name: Zak Malamed
subject: Is there anything I can say to convince you to donate to defeat George Santos?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ZAK FOR CONGRESS
body:
Today marks one month since we launched our campaign to stop Santos and flip this district blue.
#
**Today marks one month since we launched our campaign to defeat George Santos and flip this district blue.**
In that time, we have seen a huge surge in momentum and excitement from people across the district — and beyond. But knowing the steep hill we have to climb between now and Election Day to pull this off, I have to ask...
[**Is there anything I could tell you that might convince you to make a contribution before midnight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/zm-email-20230615?amount=5&refcode=em20230615&refcode2=108_8507_WwWcq-&akid=108%2E8507%2EWwWcq-)
\- What if I told you that my opponent, George Santos, represents a wave of **right-wing extremism** in my community that undermines the values we hold dear?
\- What if I mentioned that this district, New York’s 3rd, voted for Joe Biden in 2020 but is now a **toss-up** that could shift the balance of power in the House?
\- What if I told you that pundits and press are watching this race closely, recognizing its potential to be one of the **closest and most important** of the year?
\- And what if I shared that running a competitive campaign in NY-03 will be among the most **expensive races** in the country? Given the district's critical importance, we expect the Republicans to pour millions into defending Santos, escalating our own campaign expenses.
Our goal is to raise enough to send an unmistakable message to the pundits and press about the strength of our campaign. But we cannot do it without seeing one more big surge right now — before we officially wrap up our first month in this race. **So, I’m asking you:**
[**Can I count on you to contribute to kickstart our campaign? Every dollar you are able to give now will make a big difference over the coming months.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/zm-email-20230615?amount=5&refcode=em20230615&refcode2=108_8507_WwWcq-&akid=108%2E8507%2EWwWcq-)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/zm-email-20230615?amount=5&refcode=em20230615&refcode2=108_8507_WwWcq-&akid=108%2E8507%2EWwWcq-)**
Thank you for being with us from day one. Let's reclaim NY-03 together.
Sincerely,
**Zak Malamed**
Candidate for NY-03
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/zm-email-20230615?amount=5&refcode=em20230615&refcode2=108_8507_WwWcq-&akid=108%2E8507%2EWwWcq-)

body:
I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians.
| | |

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64867475/411521685/-1980373688?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk268-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjM5M2IxNy04OTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zJP4AyFhePuDmbSK9oo4bzaRxkS1eVAKU815sSqFSLo=)Hi friend – before I ask you to chip in to help me win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue, I need to take a moment to explain why I'm in this fight and what your grassroots contribution would mean today. I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter. **I’ll be honest with you, friend:** Over the years, we've seen manufacturing jobs shipped overseas because of bad trade deals, prices skyrocketing as wages failed to keep up, and hopes for a comfortable retirement dashed. That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the idea that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do.
**Every day in the Senate, I'm fighting for _you._ B****ut I’m facing my toughest race yet, and I need your help to win.** **[Will you chip in $5 or more now – before our critical mid-month fundraising deadline – so I can keep up the fight in Ohio and defend the Senate for Democrats?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64867476/411521686/691330013?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk268-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjM5M2IxNy04OTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zJP4AyFhePuDmbSK9oo4bzaRxkS1eVAKU815sSqFSLo=)**

Right now, Mitch McConnell and the GOP need to flip only two seats to retake Senate control – and experts at _Politico_ say it could all come down to Ohio. Last year’s Senate race here was one of the most costly in the nation, and _NBC News_ reports this one could be “even nastier and more expensive.”
**That's why I simply cannot win this race – and Democrats simply cannot hold on to our narrow Senate majority – without grassroots support from folks like you. As one of the most vulnerable senators in the country, I'm personally asking: **

**[Will you please rush $5 now – or any amount that's meaningful to you – to help us hit our ambitious $50,000 mid-month goal, power our reelection campaign to victory, and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64867479/411521687/691330013?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk268-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjM5M2IxNy04OTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zJP4AyFhePuDmbSK9oo4bzaRxkS1eVAKU815sSqFSLo=)**
This is gonna be a heck of a fight, but with you by my side, I know we can beat the odds and continue making much-needed progress for workers and families. Thanks for being on our team.

With gratitude,

Sherrod

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics. | | Paid for by Vivek 2024 Contributions to Vivek 2024 are not deductible as charitable contributions for Federal income tax purposes. **Last night, Tucker Carlson weighed in.** On his new Twitter show, he presented his own dangerous, baseless conspiracy theory on Trump’s indictment. He may not be on Fox News anymore, but incredibly, his show still reached millions of people in just a few short hours.
Right-wing bad actors like Tucker are working day and night to undermine our justice system and help Trump become President again. That makes Courier’s work to correct the record more important than ever — **especially in battleground states that will decide the 2024 election.**

body:
Podcast, radio show, conversations...
| | | |
---
# Morgan Ortagus, Former Spokesperson
# for the US Department of State
---
In this episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Morgan Ortagus, founder of POLARIS National Security and former Spokesperson for the US Department of State. Morgan shares what it was like growing up with an identical twin in central Florida and how the events of 9/11 changed her academic and professional pursuits. She discusses the Abraham Accords, threats emerging from Iran, the Uyghur genocide in Xinjiang, and the coordinated efforts (led by China) to undermine the US dollar. Along the way, Morgan also reflects on country music, her reading list, and the existential risks produced by a divided America.
Tune in via the links below!

---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!
For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times!
You'll find my conversations with David Jordan, Founder of Seven Hills Foundation, John Avlon, Senior Political Analyst at CNN, Derek Leathers, Chairman & CEO of Werner Enterprises, Rudy Glocker, Founder of Burgeon Outdoor, former US Senator Kelly Ayotte, NCUA Vice Chair Kyle Hauptman, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, NH Governor Chris Sununu, NH Education Czar Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Business and Economic Affairs Taylor Caswell, GOP Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, former Commander of NORAD and Retired Four Star General Lori Robinson, and former Chair of House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence Mike Rogers.

We’re midway through Pride Month, and right now we’re celebrating Pride by taking action.

| Peter, Join us today at 4:30PM EDT for a NEW LIVE episode of the Common Ground Podcast. We'll be diving into a critical topic that affects not just adults, but our children and teenagers as well: **mental health**.
There is a paramount need for resources and care dedicated to the mental health of our youth. While adults can undeniably face their own mental health challenges, the unique stresses and pressures confronting our children in today's world are substantial and deserve our focused attention. These pressures extend from the academic arena to the pervasive influence of social media, from the personal journey of identity formation to the daunting task of coming to terms with the world's harsh realities.

---
| | [CLICK HERE TO ACCESS THE COMMON GROUND STREAM NOW (WE'LL BE LIVE AT 4:30PM EDT)](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/36f990e69f13325e55f0cb194ce0ce14/eJyNj00LglAQRf_LrCXxo0XuRCQemouodZgO9Uifj-comfjfGytqU9B25txzuSMQqlyRKCGAK91c1wMLDBZSS1QUNYry4vF1l77jORZUUl3Wpuk0BOPX8BuYz47jcoYGjYzstmGUiGx9SEWWMKlzwx1_eVb-RxNvQpHCNP30Yi0p7lndQkCmw3lQKXkU7U3F_JlIt4FtF01dN-rEHapcFFV3tCvZIwtyrVGVr_EJDk_NdAfEi2Kn)

| Today's special guests include New Jersey Senator Vin Gopal, Tommy Hudanish from the Nicholas Hudanish Foundation, Sheriff James Gannon of Morris County, Mark Taylor, Mayor of Florham Park, and Ace Gallager, Mayor of Hanover. All of these incredible individuals believe in the importance of providing our youth with mental health resources that are readily available to them.
**One free resource that's right around the corner is our[Free Addiction, Mental Health & Suicide Prevention Seminar](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/cff595e0c26309c04c6968536e311bcf/eJyNkMFqwkAQht9lzqHZ3SRIAqWIiIRYD9Kew7KZ4KJuhs1ojZJ3d1OLpxYKc9r59vv55waMTjsuGyjgwlelEojAo7Fk0fGic6zN91ZlqUxkBAfr9ivfnQiK26-fn8D0LKWaRcADYUA-tvNFVW5W9brcVIEk7UPGvzx5Kp-a5fu8XMM4_unFo-XlOah7KNifcCrU2FCKP_0h8Dtm6os4Jo8TZTtHmndfeuhfTHeM36xra_NoXu9xeDW5ErMkSVUrpGyxlZnJTRiRCiGaTIRITYSu-TlXhcMjeLwDg1JyMA==) happening on June 28th.**
---
| Whether you are a parent who worries that your teenager may be fighting addiction, depression, anxiety or thoughts of suicide, or a middle/high school student who is struggling and doesn't know where to turn, this event is for you. We will be sharing effective strategies to prevent, identify, and address the most pressing mental health and addiction struggles that our youth face today. There will be a live streaming option for those who can't join in person. [**Click here to learn more and join this free, life-changing seminar.**](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/b30ed2801d04a20d152597a75b16a2d9/eJyNkMFqwkAQht9lzqHZ3SRIAqWIiISoh6LnsGwmuKibYTO2Rsm7d1OLpxYKc9r59vv55w6MTjsuGyjgyjelEojAo7Fk0fGic6zN91ZlqUxkBCfrjivfXQiK-6-fn8D0LKXKIuCBMCC79_miKrerel1uq0CS9iHjX548lU_NcjMv1zCOf3rxbHn5EdQ9FOwvOBVqbCjFe38K_IGZ-iKOyeNE2c6R5sOnHvoX053jN-va2jya10ccXk2uxCxJUtUKKVtsZWZyE0akQogmEyFSE6Frfs5V4fAIHr8AgVpyLg==)

As I continue to travel to further develop our rapidly growing organization, Elizabeth will showcase her expertise as an author, speaker, entrepreneur, mindset maven, and patriot while she dives deep into the topic of mental health and how we can help our youth overcome the biggest challenges that face them today.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**[Join All On The Line in reaffirming our commitment to the fight for fair redistricting.
