Our movement draws strength from the courage and conviction President Kennedy showed 60 years ago when he called for civil rights legislation in a nationally-televised address -- and the tireless civil rights workers, organizers, and activists who carried the torch of progress forward, even as they were met with fierce opposition, violence, and brutality. It is in these extraordinary moments -- these complex and contradictory chapters in the life of our nation -- that America’s character is revealed, and our future determined.
Our nation’s history since 1963 has been marked by both remarkable struggle and progress. **Last week, our movement for fair maps secured a huge victory with the landmark redistricting decision,_Allen v. Milligan_ , ultimately setting course for Black Alabamians to have equal representation in their state.** And though we are celebrating this momentous victory, we can never be satisfied with mere “progress.” Progress is not our goal; it is simply a measure of our commitment, a marker in time. Our pursuit for equal representation and justice must continue -- and it must endure.
**[Now, more than ever, our work inside and outside the courts, in our communities, and at the ballot box is crucial to achieving fair maps. Will you support our work and chip into All On The Line today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64876554/411554129/-1316552396?refcode=20230615_AOTL_P_EHHA2_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI4ZWU1ZGUzLTk5MGItZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Vn_I5qIIApgplUWgy1sPW0KItn6GYNRvuURcOcveQzQ=)**

As we continue to celebrate last week’s triumph in Alabama and honor those who have paved the way for our freedoms, we must set a course for the future. We must strive for true equality and justice in every facet of our society. Our journey toward equal rights and fair representation stretches beyond the horizon. I implore you, my friends, to be inspired -- and, more importantly, to be impatient. **Do not settle for mere progress; strive for lasting change.**
\-- Eric H. Holder, Jr.

clean_body: | Team, As our nation reflects on 60 years since 1963, a transformational year in the civil rights movement, I am reminded of the progress that we have made in this span of time and the work that lies ahead as we relentlessly pursue the full promise of our democracy. = = Our movement draws strength from the courage and conviction President Kennedy showed 60 years ago when he called for civil rights legislation in a nationally-televised address -- and the tireless civil rights workers, organizers, and activists who carried the torch of progress forward, even as they were met with fierce opposition, violence, and brutality. It is in these extraordinary moments -- these complex and contradictory chapters in the life of our nation -- that America’s character is revealed, and our future determined. Our nation’s history since 1963 has been marked by both remarkable struggle and progress. Last week, our movement for fair maps secured a huge victory with the landmark redistricting decision,Allen v. Milligan , ultimately setting course for Black Alabamians to have equal representation in their state. And though we are celebrating this momentous victory, we can never be satisfied with mere “progress.” Progress is not our goal; it is simply a measure of our commitment, a marker in time. Our pursuit for equal representation and justice must continue -- and it must endure. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = As we continue to celebrate last week’s triumph in Alabama and honor those who have paved the way for our freedoms, we must set a course for the future. We must strive for true equality and justice in every facet of our society. Our journey toward equal rights and fair representation stretches beyond the horizon. I implore you, my friends, to be inspired -- and, more importantly, to be impatient. Do not settle for mere progress; strive for lasting change. \-- Eric H. subject: The first "Top Gun"
body:
I was one of the first “Top Guns” of the U.S. Air Force.

| | | [](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkL1u4zAQhJ-G6iRQyx9ThYrDHdQcHKRLKSyXK5sw9QOSdpC3D5QnSDXNzODD93GdrxhT3G5vuPL4oDznMiPP-KL2jvnFX2cELI8ZJKhW2rY3s2rCGAayaBsee-usM04NrrmPSjtltQlS9xcNdvHsmYNahiUwSO-bOJ4_0vamt2rooTOLRQoAhsB7VkpoiYlz7R7MB-3bLXMpmY-nT5Fw62hfmzTeaz2KUH8ETAKmwvTM3OHGYa9nQ8CEK-dz0L64csattMRb5SxgooUGZ8BqwwMgw2Vw_SLUVPZnJp5pDyzUv_9_37WUyjV5DMdnTCkWexFa3laM6Qej_l7YdwAAAP__xrVzlg)

Fellow American, I was one of the first “Top Guns” of the U.S. Air Force. In 1949, I was on a small pilot team at the Air Force’s first Fighter Gunnery Meet. Over multiple days, we competed against other squadrons in dive bombing, skip bombing, rocket firing, panel strafing, and aerial gunnery at 20,000 and 12,000 feet – _and we won_. But the Air Force listed the 1949 competition winner as “Unknown” for 46 years because our team was composed of Tuskegee Airmen ... and they didn’t want people to know we were so good.
---
[](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkL1u4zAQhJ-G6iRQyx9ThYrDHdQcHKRLKSyXK5sw9QOSdpC3D5QnSDXNzODD93GdrxhT3G5vuPL4oDznMiPP-KL2jvnFX2cELI8ZJKhW2rY3s2rCGAayaBsee-usM04NrrmPSjtltQlS9xcNdvHsmYNahiUwSO-bOJ4_0vamt2rooTOLRQoAhsB7VkpoiYlz7R7MB-3bLXMpmY-nT5Fw62hfmzTeaz2KUH8ETAKmwvTM3OHGYa9nQ8CEK-dz0L64csattMRb5SxgooUGZ8BqwwMgw2Vw_SLUVPZnJp5pDyzUv_9_37WUyjV5DMdnTCkWexFa3laM6Qej_l7YdwAAAP__xrVzlg)
---
_Above: My friends at the American Veterans Center recorded a special video documentary about my military service in World War II and the Korean War._
---
**I** ’**m a proud 22-year military veteran who served in World War II and the Korean War with the 33rd Fighter Group, better known as the Tuskegee Airmen.** In addition to being one of the Air Force’s first “Top Guns,” I was the first African-American combat pilot to fly in Korea, and I went on to fly more than 125 missions there. I’m proud to share my story of patriotism, service, and hard work with the next generation and to see the Tuskegee Airmen I served with recognized for their skill and bravery – after so many years of stonewalling and silence. **I truly understand the importance of recording and sharing veterans** ’ **stories so we can honor the men and women who served and inspire young Americans.** That’s why, when my friends at the American Veterans Center told me they needed to raise more funds to record veterans’ stories – from World War II to today’s Special Forces – I knew that I had to take action. [**Can I count on you to chip in $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help support the American Veterans Center** ’**s critical work to honor veterans** ’ **legacies? As a non-profit organization, AVC depends on support from patriotic Americans like you.**](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkL1u4zAQhJ-G6iRQyx9ThYrDHdQcHKRLKSyXK5sw9QOSdpC3D5QnSDXNzODD93GdrxhT3G5vuPL4oDznMiPP-KL2jvnFX2cELI8ZJKhW2rY3s2rCGAayaBsee-usM04NrrmPSjtltQlS9xcNdvHsmYNahiUwSO-bOJ4_0vamt2rooTOLRQoAhsB7VkpoiYlz7R7MB-3bLXMpmY-nT5Fw62hfmzTeaz2KUH8ETAKmwvTM3OHGYa9nQ8CEK-dz0L64csattMRb5SxgooUGZ8BqwwMgw2Vw_SLUVPZnJp5pDyzUv_9_37WUyjV5DMdnTCkWexFa3laM6Qej_l7YdwAAAP__xrVzlg)

Will you make your most generous tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more today?**](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkL1u4zAQhJ-G6iRQyx9ThYrDHdQcHKRLKSyXK5sw9QOSdpC3D5QnSDXNzODD93GdrxhT3G5vuPL4oDznMiPP-KL2jvnFX2cELI8ZJKhW2rY3s2rCGAayaBsee-usM04NrrmPSjtltQlS9xcNdvHsmYNahiUwSO-bOJ4_0vamt2rooTOLRQoAhsB7VkpoiYlz7R7MB-3bLXMpmY-nT5Fw62hfmzTeaz2KUH8ETAKmwvTM3OHGYa9nQ8CEK-dz0L64csattMRb5SxgooUGZ8BqwwMgw2Vw_SLUVPZnJp5pDyzUv_9_37WUyjV5DMdnTCkWexFa3laM6Qej_l7YdwAAAP__xrVzlg)

As a young man, I stood outside in my yard and looked up as a formation of P-40 Warhawks flew overhead. In that moment, I knew I wanted to become a pilot. **Today, I hope that my story of serving America – in World War II, in the Korean War, and as one of the first** “**Top Guns” in the Air Force – will similarly inspire the next generation of young people.** Every year, the American Veterans Center reaches _millions_ of Americans through their video documentaries ... their National Memorial Day Parade ... and their Annual Conference for veterans, students, and military cadets. We have a little saying here at FPC, and I think you’re going to like it:**

“Fuck you. **No.** ”

Because that’s the _only_ thing you can say to anti-gun radicals who hate us, hate our families, and hate our rights.

For far too long, **gun owners have been stabbed in the back with “compromises”** that eroded our basic right to own a firearm.

Unlike some, **FPC knows these gun grabbers will _never_ be appeased**...because the only thing they care about is disarming you and your family.

Anti-gun politicians can kick and scream all they want. We don’t care about them.

**We’re fighting for our gun rights on the _only_ playing field that matters: America’s court system.**

**FPC has built the greatest pro-2A legal team ever to exist**...and we’re not just fighting the “big” fights, but fighting every single attempt to erode the Second Amendment.

Because we know **if we give anti-gun crazies _even one inch_ , they’ll take a mile.**

Right now, FPC is leading the charge on a major lawsuit to stop Biden’s ATF from banning pistol braces. We’ve already scored a major early success: a judge decided that FPC members are covered by an injunction.

But look: **waging an all-out war against the Federal Government and deep-pocketed gun grabbers is expensive, exhausting, and all-consuming.**

We do NOT yet have the resources to continue fighting wherever we need to go.

**[That’s why I hope you’ll pitch in just a few bucks to join FPC...and make sure that the best 2A legal team in America has everything we need to defend our rights in court.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxMj82OozAQhJ-muQXhBv9w4JBdxB5W2mOkPSFjm8QjGjsGhHj7EZloNNevSv11aYqTH48G5C9AfHi7ACKUV0B8_t8pbR_098_ldr1dnuIf8TPE34C4HtF9N99HckfaTyeVbWYbLfTobOYaJpRQlVRKZo-mqge02pmBCVkqJofaKYOMDUwWA-cq8w0WWBaCcSaqmmNeWcYro6zVxpiac6iKlyjXbNcphUC5CZRNzWNd4_L6qAPsFme25PLRJ6cTLTFM3hx5SHfALlBvw9yP0fSDXlz_ZSw4lN22Ur-ELRkHZbuHeY2TPmZvHKA4M3LWbwRlG-hNjKao_X3-yVaXzs6eAIWmsM0rlC3yLDU27n6a_CIkVMX9tcME-gwAAP__84h7EQ)**

Don’t give them one inch, Friend. **Join me in saying, “Fuck you. NO!” to the radicals who want to strip you and your family of your basic rights.**

**[Join FPC with a contribution of any amount, big or small, to help us hold the line and win these battles for the Second Amendment.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxMj82OozAQhJ-muQXhBv9w4JBdxB5W2mOkPSFjm8QjGjsGhHj7EZloNNevSv11aYqTH48G5C9AfHi7ACKUV0B8_t8pbR_098_ldr1dnuIf8TPE34C4HtF9N99HckfaTyeVbWYbLfTobOYaJpRQlVRKZo-mqge02pmBCVkqJofaKYOMDUwWA-cq8w0WWBaCcSaqmmNeWcYro6zVxpiac6iKlyjXbNcphUC5CZRNzWNd4_L6qAPsFme25PLRJ6cTLTFM3hx5SHfALlBvw9yP0fSDXlz_ZSw4lN22Ur-ELRkHZbuHeY2TPmZvHKA4M3LWbwRlG-hNjKao_X3-yVaXzs6eAIWmsM0rlC3yLDU27n6a_CIkVMX9tcME-gwAAP__84h7EQ)**

body:
Somewhere along the way, America forgot it was founded on truth. The politicians and media don't want you to be reminded of these facts.

| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsmbpva0stnchslup55plk479ughp1gb70clk728_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm2or2c9h2bs)

Fellow American,

**TRUTH.** There's only one. Not yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic political climate where spin is all the Administrative state knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to say them:

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** CHIP IN IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zn3mk5pv9crniil6bt1k9vleampmp6duo4arklg8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm2or2c9h2bs)

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. **Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.**

If you agree with these 10 TRUTHS, _**[I need you on my team.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlp4465r69k0s9jvjo0r8bv6u1go0topujdaslno_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm2or2c9h2bs)**_

Vivek Ramaswamy

[** STAND WITH THE TRUTH **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd9db8mrlb7mljbvhebrh0bv9llthu3rnv1athm8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm2or2c9h2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

_If the president decides we need to go to war, he needs to come to Congress and ask for approval, just as the Constitution states._**__[I AGREE >>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=da066d4821a44da29fe3e3df37beec4a&_e=z_yc-gS_9-tUR2Z-U8_QxgXzw-FgManVP19_Hbm0IPs4PMx6zI4jq6oyYqAY3KFqHG4YTr53CQGPqM_dIQm4vaY1IPGAbvjSuX-_hB0bsrqBAeH0b597vYgrj_3kXDajDF8G0fc-h2TRnbhPN_epbwVM_uZOsZ0PGJPhKlk_U57CYIFZDFI3rYyFX4T4ilqD6bBX7vfQh4GdAmao9rU6ZECoo6cv8Xa6QdobaUWX9kLpU7Fq70Y9RvLL2zU8Wl9dALzYwk2Yklh9MZjyEMUtFY2lGe8bnuvUCY3nKxMvmn8zmMkccGqGoi_4rR0gM-p4X8JdmTqQXm-_QNCrjoLqkIrRmdgaNjxnbVyV5MWxo5qHhx6YEtPoFl-ZeYNerFBn)__**

(Me getting a fresh cut)_ Hey friend, happy Thursday!

I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I’m in this fight.

I’m not the kind of guy you’d expect to see in Congress. I still get $12 flattop haircuts. And at home on the farm, I butcher my own meat.

I didn’t come to Washington to play into partisan hogwash—I came because I didn’t see anyone in our government sticking up for rural communities like mine.

I’m running to continue to deliver for Montanans, from holding our government accountable to standing up for veterans and protecting the Montana way of life.

**But with Mitch McConnell and his dark money backers hellbent on taking back the Senate majority and targeting my seat to make their pipe dream a reality, I’ll need all the help I can get from my grassroots team.**

[**Will you split a donation of any amount today between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to help protect our Democratic majority and keep me fighting in the Senate for hardworking Montanans and their families?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/47751?t=7&akid=8493%2E878179%2E4ENVAS) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/47752?t=8&akid=8493%2E878179%2E4ENVAS)

#
Hey Derek, it's John.
You know, from Day One, this team has been united by a belief — that together, we’re able to accomplish more than any one of us can alone. 💪
Coming together to work towards something bigger than the sum of its parts is what led us to victory and flipped Pennsylvania last year.
Knowing people across PA + the country have my back has helped as we’ve had some pretty tough times this year.
**And having so many folks on this team is what keeps me fighting for yinz + youse in the U.S. Senate every day.**
I might be the one in DC casting votes, but it’s folks like you from 18326 and all over the country who make our movement so powerful.
**[Derek, I’m always grateful for your support – and we don’t take a single donation for granted. name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Join the Fight Against Chemical Abortion
body:
His ad claims it's all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

| [ ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z49a3qf3ojbvj6lfapnkqruftngkiniq23m6mnlo_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm6ob2cph2bs)
---
Friend,

Five seconds.

That's how long it took President Biden to endorse abortion in his latest campaign ad. It's what he's running on. It's what he stands for: Taxpayer-funded abortion on demand up to birth.

His ad claims it's all about freedom, but his actions show the opposite.

Since coming into office, the Biden administration has worked to:
* Illegally force American taxpayers to fund abortion with their hard-earned dollars.
* Ignore violent threats and attacks on pro-life organizations and individuals.
* Trample on the rights of parents and healthcare providers.

Just six days after being sworn in, Biden signed an executive order to repeal the Global Protect Life policy--forcing American taxpayers to fund groups promoting abortion overseas. But he didn't stop there.

Within months, he rolled back President Trump's Protect Life Rule, funneling taxpayer dollars to abortion businesses through Title X. And he forced Americans to fund abortion in his Covid-19 relief package!

On top of all this, the Biden administration has been weaponizing the DOJ against the pro-life community. They put a target on anyone how dares to tell the truth that abortion takes the life of an innocent child--all while ignoring violence against peaceful pro-life organizations and individuals.

This is not only outrageous--it's dangerous.

But that hasn't stopped President Biden from going all-in on a radical pro-abortion agenda to fire up his base going into 2024. He is determined to rewrite all the rules--including the U.S. Constitution--to get his way.

That's why I'm emailing you today.

SBA Pro-Life America is fighting back against the Biden administration and its radical abortion agenda every single day. Our team is working around the clock to advance pro-life laws through direct lobbying and grassroots campaigns. And we are fighting to end abortion by electing national leaders who advocate for laws that save lives--with a special calling to promote pro-life women leaders.

**[But in order to do this critical work, we need your help.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo92ugubvabk436e5lrilo2or7co88n4ikkjjqo8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm6ob2cph2bs)**

Your gift today will allow us to expand our policy research efforts to further educate lawmakers across the country. And it will help us to grow our voter education initiative to ensure that pro-life Americans know the truth about where the Biden administration and other pro-abortion leaders stand on abortion.

You can make your gift right now using this secure link: **[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/stand-up-to-biden-harris](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6s12h3kaihk48ge6rqq68anoau0dme8apdfrar8_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm6ob2cph2bs)**

But please remember that time is of the essence. As President Biden ramps up his campaign efforts, we must be prepared to counter him every step of the way.

That's why your gift is urgently needed now.

Make your gift today to fight back against the Biden administration using this secure link: **[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/stand-up-to-biden-harris](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5qcbp2qk0tgam3gi8qatg4170478lil6onaauro_rp22sh2s8i66o73c3hm6ob2cph2bs)**

By doing so, you will help advance a culture of life that protects unborn children and their mothers from abortion.

For _LIFE_ ,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

Friend, Whether it’s in the halls of Congress, at rallies, or at protests in the streets, we all need allies by our side fighting for real systemic change. **Rep. Delia Ramirez is the first Latina Congresswoman elected from the Midwest. Like me, she’s the daughter of immigrants and** **she too, understands the struggles of working people.** In just her first 5 months in office, Delia’s work has been critical in fighting back against right-wing attacks on services for seniors and vulnerable communities, including Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, and SNAP. Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy's are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> "We're going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years..."
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she's found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a76577fb3b04f768bb42d12d7e53572&_e=juf4BgJQA261IaEvW3URTg0DT6NgZCfFOpDoz728W66j22tuXHGOnpXtzv1BBR63sVsmQS4UWW_O0uHQvisyK0gXneO-nliYBW7hdtWAoo5CMnSP8wXfnoBcWU47ZQL35mo713XBlS5u5RY0dp3YM254VteKRuz--woek5j8xjq15p6iLXWHOfVOcM1Rw0XwqKn-U7m0o4hEsrBUVF5S07U-c08Mer5gHY_YyYbYuMqz41cU7RdbMXDczp4V3Mxe) Dr. Prins says:
> "This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we're about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result."
According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she's recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a 'reset' to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

For unborn children, chemical abortion means grisly death. The drugs used in this procedure are designed to stop the heart of the developing fetus, leading to its expulsion from the womb. This callous disregard for the sanctity of human life is a tragedy that we must do all we can to prevent.

Dear Fellow Patriot, This past week was full of significant highs and lows.The low of this week was watching the unprecedented and dangerous indictment of former President Donald Trump. As you may know, earlier this year, AFL's investigation revealed that the Biden White House was involved with the partisan raid of Mar-a-Lago and that the National Archives misled Congress. It appears that the Biden White House and DOJ coordinated to obtain the Trump records and perhaps create a pretext for the law enforcement raid by way of a “special access request". A full statement on the indictment by AFL's VP and General Counsel Gene Hamilton can be found here: [_https://aflegal.org/america-first-legal-responds-to-the-indictment-of-president-trump-by-special-counsel-jack-smith/_](http://xykkk.mjt.lu/lnk/AVgAABqYayUAAAAN684AAEcY2LAAAAABL9MAAGV0ABg1MgBki2DcREDhgF7bTYu_IAamp1CX_gAXqZI/2/eSfo2EQFATLhlAoxvN3o1g/aHR0cHM6Ly9hZmxlZ2FsLm9yZy9hbWVyaWNhLWZpcnN0LWxlZ2FsLXJlc3BvbmRzLXRvLXRoZS1pbmRpY3RtZW50LW9mLXByZXNpZGVudC10cnVtcC1ieS1zcGVjaWFsLWNvdW5zZWwtamFjay1zbWl0aC8) The high of this week was the major victory that AFL scored for the First Amendment in South Carolina. AFL and co-counsel Christopher Mills won our lawsuit to stop establishment politicians from silencing the South Carolina Freedom Caucus. In a forty-page opinion, United States District Court Judge Cameron Currie permanently blocked the enforcement of state statutes that sought to limit the expressive and associational activities of the Freedom Caucus and other “legislative special interest caucuses,” finding them to be “a ban on speech.” The court held that these laws, written to favor the House Democratic Caucus, House Republican Caucus, the Black Caucus, and the Women’s Caucus, violated the Freedom Caucus’s First Amendment and Equal Protection rights. More here: [_https://aflegal.org/major-victory-america-first-legal-prevails-in-lawsuit-to-protect-the-south-carolina-freedom-caucus-right-to-free-speech_](http://xykkk.mjt.lu/lnk/AVgAABqYayUAAAAN684AAEcY2LAAAAABL9MAAGV0ABg1MgBki2DcREDhgF7bTYu_IAamp1CX_gAXqZI/3/BQ9uG0L0u9L6T55G1OW5-Q/aHR0cHM6Ly9hZmxlZ2FsLm9yZy9tYWpvci12aWN0b3J5LWFtZXJpY2EtZmlyc3QtbGVnYWwtcHJldmFpbHMtaW4tbGF3c3VpdC10by1wcm90ZWN0LXRoZS1zb3V0aC1jYXJvbGluYS1mcmVlZG9tLWNhdWN1cy1yaWdodC10by1mcmVlLXNwZWVjaA) Another significant development from the past week is our new lawsuit against the DOJ to force compliance with our FOIA request. On January 3, 2023, AFL submitted a FOIA request to the DOJ to shed light on a series of sexual assaults that occurred at Loudoun County Public Schools and sought the DOJ’s communications with District and County officials and other communications relating to the assaults and ensuing grand jury investigation. On April 20, 2023, DOJ replied and estimated that the search phase of the request would be complete in “nine to ten months.” Then, the DOJ indicated that after the search was completed, additional time would be required to review the records and begin production. America First Legal is committed to uncovering these records and is holding the federal government accountable under the law. Hey Peter,

As Washington’s commissioner of public lands, I made a promise to ensure that our state’s future generations are able to appreciate our farms, forests, and communities just as I have. **And I never break a promise.**

That’s why I’m running for governor – to continue to make good on my promise and deliver tangible results that protect our land, waters, and communities and create countless jobs and opportunities along the way.

We’re at a critical crossroads, Peter, where the impacts of climate change are bearing down on all of us, and if we don’t act now, we risk losing the Evergreen State as we know it.

I’m committed to tackling these challenges headfirst, and as governor, I plan to bring the same determination and boldness that I brought to my job as commissioner. Because frankly, Peter, our state faces challenges that are too big for us to play it safe anymore. **But, I can’t do this work alone.[ That’s why I’m counting on you, Peter, to join me and pitch in what you’re able before my team’s big mid-month deadline tonight. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. In addition, they have three dogs: Lucy and Ellie, Boston Terriers, and their famous Babydog, an English Bulldog.

Teammates — it’s Patrick Denny, Finance Director for Wes Moore here. You might be wondering why the heck I'm still here asking for money – we got Wes and Aruna elected, so why keep fundraising? **[I'll explain in a second, but first I want to ask if you'll help keep us on track to raise $20,000 this month by pitching in your first donation of $5 (or whatever you can) right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64887552/411592608/-1246499856?refcode=fl_em_fr_20230615mm2_twm_180da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjJhZGUyNi1iNTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f7PLQy0vWLehkzssS7R0XiAic4IrWuVKIAf8e3OKaKk=)** Here's why we're still fundraising for the campaign:
1. **Stay ready so you don't have to get ready.** It's a lot harder to start a massive campaign operation like ours when everything's gone dark for two years than if you keep a few lights on. We don't want to start a re-election campaign at a disadvantage.

2. **There will always be those who try to take Maryland backward.** We know that the fight for what is right is simply never done. Already we've seen the NRA _sue_ our state simply because Wes signed new gun safety legislation. Having the resources to communicate the work Wes is doing is critical.

3. **Why put off to tomorrow what you can do today?** If you ever left a homework assignment to the last minute, it's the same idea for a campaign. Just like it's easier if you break up a big assignment into smaller deadlines, it's a lot easier for my team to get the job done if we keep a steady fundraising pace now rather than wait two years.

Our fundraising goals these days are smaller than they were a year ago, but they're just as important to hit if we want to keep building a Maryland where no one is left behind. **[We need to raise $20,000 before our end-of-quarter deadline on June 30. June 15, 2023
**The Tulare County Republican Party Endorses Michael Maher for Congress** The [_Tulare County Republican Party_](https://michaelmaher.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6239b7d9cb3ad9388556be8be&id=c07486ccbe&e=1722d05e10 "https://www.tularegop.com/") recently announced its endorsement of Michael Maher’s Congressional race in the 21st district.

In the organization’s endorsement, Tulare County GOP wrote, “Michael Maher is a homegrown Republican who will protect the interests of Tulare County and be a strong voice for us in a Republican majority Congress. We are thrilled to endorse and support his campaign. Michael Maher is a bright young star for the Central Valley and the GOP.”

The Tulare County Republican Party joins a growing list of local leaders and organizations endorsing Michael Maher’s campaign for Congress, including Tulare County Sheriff Mike Boudreaux, Fresno County Republican Party, and Congresswoman Connie Conway.

Hey, Peter. Attorney General Jason Miyares here. We aren’t quite half-way through the year, and my team has had some BIG wins for Virginians. Just in the last few months we’ve....
---
| | _**Q2 Accomplishments (With More to Come!)**_
---
* Went head-to-head with DC leaders over their soft-on-crime policies impacting Northern Virginians.
* Led a bipartisan coalition of attorneys general asking the Supreme Court to protect and uphold veterans’ rights.
* Led a bipartisan coalition of attorneys general in supporting Florida’s lawsuit against the Biden administration’s unconstitutional immigration policies.
* Joined 23 other attorneys general demanding the EPA stops trampling on Virginians’ water and property rights.
* Called on JPMorgan to stop discriminating against Virginians based on their faith and/or political affiliations.
* Joined almost two dozen other attorneys general calling on the Biden administration to protect female athletes.
* Joined an 18-state coalition suing the Biden administration over their decision to eliminate Title 42.
* Urged the Senate to classify fentanyl as a controlled substance.
* Reached a $3 million settlement with 1st Adult & Pediatrics Healthcare over fraudulent billing practices.
* Received a $137.3 million payment from tobacco companies for violating consumer protection laws and deceptive marketing practices.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Wanted to share some thoughts after yesterday’s vote
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

Yesterday, far-right Republicans brought up a resolution to censure and
fine me $16 million dollars. You’ve heard a lot from me and my team in
recent weeks about this attack, but I want to tell you a bit more of what
it was like to go through for me personally.

The House chamber was filled with members, which is rare. Steve Bannon and
others in the MAGA world had been promoting this sop to Trump, and there
was some drama around it. It was, after all, Donald Trump’s birthday. More
important, it was the day after Trump’s indictment and the MAGA
Republicans in the House were looking to change the subject. Republicans
view me as Trump’s most effective adversary, and resent the work I did to
impeach him and as part of the January 6th Committee.

Normally the reading of a resolution is waived, but the MAGA folks wanted
to read every word of their false and defamatory bill into the record, and
I can tell you, it was maddening to sit there and listen to these smears
about my work and my character read to the entire House without the
opportunity to respond.

But then, something very unexpected happened. The Republicans’ House
majority fractured — albeit slightly — when forced to vote on one of the
most extreme measures Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans have taken up
yet. Twenty House Republicans — almost one out of every ten — voted
against the measure and it was defeated on a strong bipartisan vote.

I was shocked. I never imagined they would bring the bill to a vote if
they hadn’t locked down the votes. But sadly, this isn’t over.

After the vote, I was speaking to reporters just off the House floor when
the author of the resolution, Rep. Luna of Florida, a woman I had never
even met until that day, literally scooted by shouting out that she would
file another motion to censure me again next week. (She has only
introduced four bills in her entire tenure in Congress and three of them
are attacking me. She really needs a new hobby.)

But I’ve got news for MAGA Republicans. They can bring up a hundred
resolutions to censure me — I'm not backing down. I'm going to defend our
democracy, whatever it takes.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1561?c0=jun2023_abs_em.ijd0au&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230615_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]Join me and contribute $3 or whatever you can to help our team prepare
for the fights ahead.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1072?c0=jun2023_abs_em.0Agatv&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230615_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]EXPRESS DONATE $3

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1016?c0=jun2023_abs_em.5j4Bsc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230615_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]EXPRESS DONATE $25

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1017?c0=jun2023_abs_em.RWa6IA&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230615_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]EXPRESS DONATE $50

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1018?c0=jun2023_abs_em.9Bj7kB&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230615_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1009&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]EXPRESS DONATE $100

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jun2023_abs_em.JzRsbz&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230615_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1010&akid=2553%2E5257348%2EuqYpKe ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

After witnessing this spectacle, one of the reporters asked me whether
things have always been this bad, with members making ad hominem attacks
like this (on scooter no less), and I had to tell them:

Sadly, they’ve gotten much worse.

Republican dysfunction has reached new depths under Trump and McCarthy.
Instead of addressing the real issues that I am focused on — like
attacking homelessness and the high cost of housing — they want to attack
me. And all because I dared to hold Donald Trump accountable and do my
job.

This isn’t only a dangerous precedent to set, but is also grossly
irresponsible.

For every political stunt Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans bring to the
House floor, critical time is wasted in passing legislation that would
make a real difference to the American people. And not just on housing.
But also on health care. On climate change. On rising prices. On
childcare.

Our country deserves better. Our democracy deserves better. YOU deserve
better, Derek.

That’s a big reason why I’m running for the U.S. Senate. Because we all
deserve a government that gets stuff done, and doesn’t get bogged down in
petty grievances, personal vendettas, or political stunts. And yesterday’s
vote only made me more determined than ever to fight for California and
for our democracy.

Thank you for all your support at such a critical time. I am deeply
grateful.

— Adam

Fitch is flat-out wrong for Mississippi, and straight-up dangerous to our country

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64891211/411605033/-456841951?refcode=EM_PET_230615VotingRights_GHQ_5_90DO_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzNDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzQyZGZjODEtYmMwYi1lZTExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EwlAi0buTQtblldqKJy4u2fZtETcpxFs_yL4Xr3DYKQ=) Peter,

America had a _major_ win for voting rights last week when The Supreme Court ruled in favor of Black voters who were challenging unconstitutionally drawn districts in Alabama. This unexpected victory means racially gerrymandered districts are more likely challenged and redrawn, so all voters have their votes counted equally in our elections.

Can you guess who stood against this win for democracy and voters? That’s right – Lynn Fitch.

It’s par for the course with her. As Attorney General, Fitch has used her office to attack our basic rights time and time again. That matters in Mississippi, Peter – and it matters across the country, too. Fitch has filed dozens of briefs (including this one!) challenging laws in other states and at the federal level. Joining in on attacks on our voting rights is just the latest in a long list of ways Fitch has ignored the duties of her office in favor of advancing her own personal political agenda.

| The Inflation Reduction Act is monumental for many reasons. This landmark law fights climate change, invests in our communities, and tackles the rising costs of prescription drugs.

Every dollar you invest in the Jane Fonda Climate PAC has an immediate impact in the decisions we make, and we cannot do it without you.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64892072/411607582/-1917331050?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQwYjA5ODQzLWJmMGItZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5hG29Ve2RxR7mNbKKZnaxPNa2nzKdx5q2GZWucNBajU=&emci=33b09843-bf0b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=40b09843-bf0b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=4823105)

| Hi, it’s Jane Fonda. If you’re reading this, it’s likely you receive a lot of emails from us. I wanted to take a moment to explain why we send them and why your support matters to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and the candidates we support.

_**Here are 3 reasons why every investment counts:**_

1️⃣ _**We rely on grassroots supporters like you.**_ We wish we didn’t have to ask people to part with their hard-earned money, but our ability to support candidates depends on a lot of individuals being willing to support however they can.

2️⃣ _**We focus our support where we can have the biggest impact.**_ Our strategy combines direct financial support and smartly leveraging our ability to reach people in down-ballot races where even modest financial support goes a long way. **And with your support in 2023, we have already been able to fuel the victories of Shontel Lewis and Sarah Parady for Denver City Council, Jalen McKee Rodriguez and Teri Castillo in Texas, and Sara Innamorato in PA, and with your support we will be able to support many more this year.**

3️⃣ _**The climate crisis is here.**_ Day after day, we are seeing the effects of burning fossils on our communities. The fossil fuel industry is dedicated to investing in politicians who will let them continue to get away with it. We can’t take a break from demanding climate action because the climate crisis is getting worse every day. And with your support, I strongly believe the climate movement is in great hands, but there is still so much work to be done.

We don’t say any of this to scare you – anyone who tries to scare you into giving them money should rethink that strategy. If nothing else, our goal is for you to feel hopeful – our team and the rest of the climate movement are working every day out of hope for a livable future, and we hope you consider yourself part of our team.

body:
Many pundits predict it’s a forgone conclusion that the Supreme Court, with its 6-3 conservative majority, will rule against the Biden administration's student loan cancellation plan — but that is by no means certain. | | | Peter,
Nearly a year ago,**** President Biden unveiled his student loan cancellation plan to provide up to $20,000 in one-time debt relief for over 40 million Americans. The plan was quickly blocked by Republican-appointed judges challenging its legality —**** leaving 26 million borrowers who had already applied, and 16 million who were already approved, in financial limbo. **Now, the Supreme Court is set to rule as soon as tomorrow on those challenges** — just as the Department of Education is confirming that student loan interest and payments will resume at the end of the summer, under the terms of the debt-ceiling deal approved by President Biden and Congress. [**As we brace for the ruling, can you add your name to our petition calling on Biden to take swift action and pursue an alternative legal pathway if SCOTUS strikes down the student-debt relief plan?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXdJUvH8Ygu3R43gD0WUPlZ4hBOhRoKsHGyS29kY6YXzj7t6IHlUPjc4vbvzD_Fck2CX6Zm0fMMGD5D073Vz08RrVWW5Oe4zSxlOkhFdrCMowwR3xEsK11VdFref5Sq1flYN5xZNHRCb44dLSp5Z-hRavNUodpabs2AyzUblMOcuNkCyp72WdS94L6PnUPXNuQ72oWMz7O9eeWuFg_eA2l0U3LIDxVhVLMez-IzWNhgsrOB-NeTd7hcIsD3u9phi0AE6UjrmuORFkPD3djSbFE0g3ym_r9p11mejxGme0cYYjBAqPdBHQemzRGS5fqzH2VEFJuBZLV1WFJsKiTYymcnP4mcI87oPM_1GucWMGfH1m/3x2/xFkf0IuZT4OA5BEG2taPRQ/h0/NetMhvvb02gwmB3ha3f6aBnCJJOCoWcwlytoJAuPKFM) **[Sign the petition »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXdJUvH8Ygu3R43gD0WUPlZ4hBOhRoKsHGyS29kY6YXzj7t6IHlUPjc4vbvzD_Fck2CX6Zm0fMMGD5D073Vz08RrVWW5Oe4zSxlOkhFdrCMowwR3xEsK11VdFref5Sq1flYN5xZNHRCb44dLSp5Z-hRavNUodpabs2AyzUblMOcuNkCyp72WdS94L6PnUPXNuQxFEcunwRC41Iqowhlfh68puaupuX_1YliNp2TLu4J1V-MJ6snoEBK2whVJI9k9Cvi7gntVK9imfTsXthIw4zuPnqcj9MziqfgVg2t2twP80-yCdzn4-XNJhdEDq-AFo1eKZ6bnnIFy1QxDS4WnAoLnWdJMd81HqHM7GT1yhtFyE/3x2/xFkf0IuZT4OA5BEG2taPRQ/h1/9AeiyzIPMF7JoTpI3rfaPvd6D-mkA4QitdMfUVLwlWg)** **And if you’d like to stay up-to-date on any upcoming changes related to student loans and repayment, please sign up for text updates from WFP by texting EDU to 30403.** Many pundits predict it’s a forgone conclusion that the Supreme Court, with its 6-3 conservative majority, will rule against the Biden administration's student loan cancellation plan — but that is by no means certain. Just last week, in a surprise 5-4 decision, we saw two conservative justices join their liberal counterparts to reject an attempt by Alabama lawmakers to racially gerrymander the state's congressional maps and dilute the power of Black voters.1[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDFCfwdmC8_rjCDmRl9A4paRhoKDWvAtWvpHD6oFONZtfDXYWo0oNRiXdDfaAO-NF57NKo2e-vbx---BFGYbvwbdbHlUcVKHNfdNPM7iNVyYGUt5igXzBR276mUXtecyVghHAniOV98nDVgIk6V4kQLD0YdIKrvXM1vLulF5-S-0gL5y8eyG2Z7uV0VMOqo3Ncpp8ZiawpCD8_5UxdO1jQNftVNiLGSQUyDsKbuUgh9Q2ygUK0UnLLHitBB41OQpePSq-Ud4GnRBwpWjBpGjxLjBAcKpygr8OuIhKFKBTQznXhhXSRgECRbNLeDhcDgScvrh8qtlmfyMzOBB00AV3JXhhsMsh5oNHrH_Mly7w-do5enoZuW1HPEHgurbvgUNM7g/3x2/xFkf0IuZT4OA5BEG2taPRQ/h2/0BFzZ3_ai5aFv70YJBjpR3PW2T27iC6Mfj8GbzizBcw) In other words — all hope is not lost, Peter. **And even if the Supreme Court does strike down Biden’s student debt relief plan, the administration could still pursue a “Plan B” by reissuing the student loan cancellation plan under a different legal authority.** Right now, Biden is relying on the HEROES Act — which allows the Secretary of Education to waive or modify loans during a national emergency, like the COVID-19 pandemic — as the legal basis for broad student debt cancellation. But if the Supreme Court rules that Biden cannot implement his current proposal to cancel up to $20,000 in federal student loan debt, he could still re-establish the program under a provision of the Higher Education Act, which confers broad authority on the President, via the Secretary of Education, to “compromise, waive, or release any right, title, claim, lien, or demand” associated with federal student loans.2[****](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDLak66yJIa2EtJL_HNnyB6JYDkwk_789hXRvZJxQYnOEdqsSsmgzBhbJMghZKstqrLRt9nX_mduWstgSRIdWWkwDixMl4Y6jg5UdxVn1OuTj9adpVXfMmDSbw4Soq6VBJw8qniJBIghSVZH5byZxLQgt7Yvfn3iHkCw7ye9WApudPxZz7Kf1RQgNHVjogWHIxaE8-teRZrq6VFLSEh7hJdWa2STOjeWKpgJiSNB1UufQTzEtUTW8WTNqMtIf5pxIt0LUssX6Va07AuilYXUtsocUZiYTmv2lH69BwGvgeVij/3x2/xFkf0IuZT4OA5BEG2taPRQ/h3/n2Qt4fwM819tdMCnQrD9FyoSGMTpBJ9ueHpXivR2L80) Unlike the HEROES Act, however, the HEA Act does not rely on a national emergency like a pandemic to issue student loan cancellation, and even if challenged, it would likely be upheld by the courts. So, Peter, whether or not the Supreme Court decides to keep this burden on a generation of borrowers — we believe that there is a viable, alternative pathway to cancel student debt. clean_body: Many pundits predict it’s a forgone conclusion that the Supreme Court, with its 6-3 conservative majority, will rule against the Biden administration's student loan cancellation plan — but that is by no means certain. | | | Peter, Nearly a year ago,** President Biden unveiled his student loan cancellation plan to provide up to $20,000 in one-time debt relief for over 40 million Americans. The plan was quickly blocked by Republican-appointed judges challenging its legality — leaving 26 million borrowers who had already applied, and 16 million who were already approved, in financial limbo. Now, the Supreme Court is set to rule as soon as tomorrow on those challenges — just as the Department of Education is confirming that student loan interest and payments will resume at the end of the summer, under the terms of the debt-ceiling deal approved by President Biden and Congress. And if you’d like to stay up-to-date on any upcoming changes related to student loans and repayment, please sign up for text updates from WFP by texting EDU to 30403. Many pundits predict it’s a forgone conclusion that the Supreme Court, with its 6-3 conservative majority, will rule against the Biden administration's student loan cancellation plan — but that is by no means certain. Just last week, in a surprise 5-4 decision, we saw two conservative justices join their liberal counterparts to reject an attempt by Alabama lawmakers to racially gerrymander the state's congressional maps and dilute the power of Black voters.1 In other words — all hope is not lost, Peter. And even if the Supreme Court does strike down Biden’s student debt relief plan, the administration could still pursue a “Plan B” by reissuing the student loan cancellation plan under a different legal authority. Right now, Biden is relying on the HEROES Act — which allows the Secretary of Education to waive or modify loans during a national emergency, like the COVID-19 pandemic — as the legal basis for broad student debt cancellation. But if the Supreme Court rules that Biden cannot implement his current proposal to cancel up to $20,000 in federal student loan debt, he could still re-establish the program under a provision of the Higher Education Act, which confers broad authority on the President, via the Secretary of Education, to “compromise, waive, or release any right, title, claim, lien, or demand” associated with federal student loans.2 Unlike the HEROES Act, however, the HEA Act does not rely on a national emergency like a pandemic to issue student loan cancellation, and even if challenged, it would likely be upheld by the courts. So, Peter, whether or not the Supreme Court decides to keep this burden on a generation of borrowers — we believe that there is a viable, alternative pathway to cancel student debt. Regardless of the ruling, we won’t stop fighting until we have canceled it for everyone. The Supreme Court is set to release more decisions as soon as tomorrow, and we'll be closely watching to see if the justices issue their opinions then. And if you’d like to stay up-to-date on what’s next in the fight for student debt relief, sign up for text updates from WFP by texting EDU to 30403. In solidarity, always, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , Democracy Now!, June, 09, 2023. 2\. , Inside Higher Ed, January, 09, 2023. Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Rainforests absorb and store carbon from the atmosphere and produce the oxygen that we need to breathe, which is why _**STOPPING deforestation**_ and _**SAVING our rainforests**_ is vital to our planet. But did you know that _**tropical deforestation**_ is also responsible for about _**10% of harmful global warming emissions worldwide?**_
_And what’s the leading cause of deforestation and the violent land conflicts that come with it, Friend?_ **You got it -- greedy agribusiness**. Meanwhile, powerful investment giant BlackRock continues to finance some of the worst agribusiness companies responsible for this environmental destruction, wielding **$10 TRILLION in assets**.

Soon, BlackRock’s investments could come at the **cost of our planet** , unless we **[ACT NOW](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1826261?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**! _**But without demonstrating enough momentum from grassroots environmentalists like you, our efforts won’t make a strong enough impact. **_

Friend, will you remain silent and let corporate bullies commit irreparable crimes and trample on human rights, rainforests, and the many living things that rely on these ecosystems to survive?== | == Rainforests absorb and store carbon from the atmosphere and produce the oxygen that we need to breathe, which is why STOPPING deforestation and SAVING our rainforests is vital to our planet. That’s why I’ve dedicated my career to tirelessly fighting for working people, our most vulnerable, and the people who never seem to get ahead in this economy. In recent years, we’ve seen too many people elected to office who forget about the people they’re supposed to serve.

They’re self-interested–protecting the rights and privileges of their donors instead of bettering the lives of every-day Pennsylvanians.

_That’s not who I am._

Throughout my career, I’ve fought to make a real difference in the lives of all Pennsylvanians.

I cracked down on waste, fraud and abuse–recovering over $1 billion in misused taxpayer funds. I fought to reduce the backlog of nearly 3,000 untested rape kits and brought sexual predators to justice. I exposed 58,000 unanswered phone calls at the child abuse hotline and demanded improvements to our child protection services. I went after millions in wasteful spending in our charter school system and got more resources for our students and teachers. And I used every tool at my disposal to protect every Pennsylvania’s right to vote.

Those fights weren’t easy. Even when members of my own party told me to give up, I never backed down. I don’t shy away from tough fights and I will always stand up for those I serve.

clean_body: = But first, let me explain why: I was born and raised in Pittsburgh. Growing up, my family was working class. My parents owned a restaurant, and worked day in and day out to put food on the table and a roof over our heads. Like so many, we faced challenges. When I wasn’t bussing tables, I umpired little league games and worked as a janitor to pay for college. I see my family in the folks I meet across our commonwealth – waiters, janitors, teachers, nurses, and others. I also see a system that’s stacked against them by the powerful and well-connected. The people I grew up and worked with simply wanted a fair shake. That’s why I’ve dedicated my career to tirelessly fighting for working people, our most vulnerable, and the people who never seem to get ahead in this economy. Our $150,000 goal is dedicated to supporting pro-choice, pro-LGBTQ+ candidates who are fighting Republican extremism at every turn. **Time is running out! Donate now to help hit our goal before MIDNIGHT and support Democratic pro-choice women fighting for freedom & autonomy nationwide:**

**[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64894391/411615505/-1552283335?sourceid=1050214&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzRhMTVkZi1jNTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qGJ18MTx3Hm7TorUp7ow8k8x1x4pg9ZwdPlqDeOO2Co=&emci=9d3aafd0-990b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=4c4a15df-c50b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=5177934)** Peter,

Yesterday we launched our two-day Loud & Proud Fund with an ambitious goal: raising $150,000 to support the women fighting for our rights and autonomy year round. Today, I'm reaching out personally, _before we close the books at midnight_ , to stress how critical it is that we reach this goal.

Just like restrictive abortion bans, anti-LGBTQ+ laws are on the rise nationwide. Republican extremists want to take this country backward, which is why we need to elect Democratic pro-choice women who will fight for *all* of us — now more than ever _._ **[This email is your _final opportunity_ to help hit this $150,000 Loud and Proud Fund goal. Can you donate by midnight](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64894398/411615512/-1552283335?sourceid=1050214&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzRhMTVkZi1jNTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qGJ18MTx3Hm7TorUp7ow8k8x1x4pg9ZwdPlqDeOO2Co=&emci=9d3aafd0-990b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=4c4a15df-c50b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=5177934)****[?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64894399/411615513/-1552283335?sourceid=1050214&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzRhMTVkZi1jNTBiLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qGJ18MTx3Hm7TorUp7ow8k8x1x4pg9ZwdPlqDeOO2Co=&emci=9d3aafd0-990b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=4c4a15df-c50b-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=5177934)**

If this pro-choice community knows one thing, it's that bodily autonomy is _not_ up for debate. The continued attacks on our most fundamental rights by anti-choice, anti-LGBTQ+ extremists are shameful and downright dangerous.

**While we celebrate Pride month, we're reminded that we're all fighting for the same objective:_The right to determine our own futures_.** We do that by standing loud and proud in our advocacy. And we do that by electing Democratic pro-choice candidates who are committed to doing the same. ****So before you log off for the night, I want to ask directly: Can I count on your support to help us reach our $150,000 goal by midnight? It's not about virtue signaling. _**Leadership is ultimately about producing results for the people that you represent --the people that you serve.**_ To produce these results, we must defeat Biden, restore energy to the executive, and reinstate common sense as a common virtue across our nation.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

# A big thank you!

**Peter -**
I am so grateful for the outpouring of support and kindness I have received since launching my campaign yesterday.

With you by my side, I know that we can make an impact on communities in and around the 8th district and the entire electoral map of Texas.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=9240885cd7&e=a2a46ff12c)
I want to remain a part of the community and raise awareness of the issues that matter to the constituents. Things like education, access to healthcare, and the struggles that everyday Texans face in our trying times.

These are the things that Texans want to change and deserve fair and compassionate representation that works to improve, and that is what I aim to be.

[**If you are ready to see real representation and see that one of us delivers for all of us, please donate to the campaign today and ensure that we have the support we need to impact the map and the lives of Texas.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=967b65ba54&e=a2a46ff12c)

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Something sinister is taking place. AIPAC and their allies are targeting
and trying to intimidate Black and Brown women candidates across the
country, threatening to spend against them if they even slightly criticize
Israel's far-right, apartheid policies.

A new billionaire-backed Super PAC is targeting and spending heavily
against a progressive City Councilwoman in Brooklyn, New York. Another
candidate in Arizona is being attacked for voting against a bill that
identifies criticism of Israel's government as antisemitic.

AIPAC is a right-wing group. They supported Donald Trump, endorsed 106
insurrection Republicans, and spent millions to defeat progressives such
as Jessica Cisneros and Summer Lee.

Let’s be clear: AIPAC has lost the public opinion battle, all they have
left is threats and the ability to spend big against progressives who
speak out in support of Palestinian human rights. And spending money
against a candidate who doesn’t even have an opponent clearly escalates
their threats.

We have no other option but to fight back against AIPAC, support our
incumbents who are taking brave stances in support of Palestinian human
rights, and recruit and elect even more candidates who will do the same.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/134987?refcode=em20230615-29447&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=29447%2E1203867%2ED7r_h9 ]We wouldn’t be reaching out to ask if it wasn’t crucial for the future
of Justice Democrats and our candidates. Will you rush a $3
contribution right now to help us fight back against AIPAC?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/134987?refcode=em20230615-29447&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=29447%2E1203867%2ED7r_h9 ]Contribute $3

No matter what, thank you for being a part of this team.

Geoff Simpson

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you're struggling, you can find a food bank

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the

body:
I try to do it with my eyes closed | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c33413741549/im-announcing-my-run-for-us-congress-in-the-8th-congressional-district-13558651?e=0e51d1e991)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=d5e740167d&e=0e51d1e991)
---
| | Peter,
---
| Washington has the 2nd highest prices for gas in the nation, _and our noble gesture at the pump is supposed to achieve positive impacts in the fight against climate change._

When really... it just puts _more_ money in the state coffers for them to dream up _more_ unrealistic Green Energy action plans that sound great, but fail to bring down harmful emissions or deliver on all the hype!
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=632ce40093&e=0e51d1e991)
---
| **Now the CO2 tax has jumped a staggering 45 cents per gallon!** This alarming increase hits the pockets of everyday consumers while families are already dealing with the additional strain of struggling with inflation.

Peter, I joke about filling up my gas tank with my eyes closed. In reality, it's the closed minds of policy-makers that are hellbent on advancing an agenda that does very little to achieve its objective!

Furthermore, these radical policies have stifled the growth and innovation of our energy industry, resulting in job losses and economic uncertainty for countless Americans.

That's why I am turning to you, Peter. [**I am asking for your help to ensure that our state has a strong and vocal advocate in Congress who will take a stand against the fantastical Green New Deal agenda that is being forced upon us with greater extremes each season.**](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=1c4bacf0e2&e=0e51d1e991)

[**Join me in challenging everyone to open their eyes to ways we can sensibly protect our environment without impoverishing families and stifling American innovation and industry:**](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=fc2bd66aea&e=0e51d1e991)
---
